def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    pos = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    x, y = pos
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    # Consolidate all potential targets
    targets = resources or enemies or border

    if targets:
        # Select the closest target based on Manhattan distance
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - x) + abs(t[1] - y))
        dx = target[0] - x
        dy = target[1] - y
        # Clamp movements to -1, 0, 1
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # No targets; try to move towards the positive x/y direction
        return [1, 1]
